literal_meaning: পৃষ্ঠ প্রদর্শন করা (to show the back)
figurative_meaning_bn: চম্পট দেওয়া; পলায়ন করা; পলায়ন; ভীরুতা প্রকাশ করা
figurative_meaning_en: to flee; to run away; to escape; to display cowardice
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিতর্কে পরাজিত হয়ে সে পৃষ্ঠপ্রদর্শন করল।
example_sentences_in_english: As soon as they saw the police, the attackers turned tail.
Defeated in the argument, he showed his back and fled.
note: This idiom vividly captures the act of turning away in fear, common in Bengali oral traditions.
